title: Final Examination - AI Foundations & Everyday Productivity
description: This final examination assesses your understanding of all five challenges in the AI Foundations & Everyday Productivity course. A minimum score of 70% is required to successfully complete the course and qualify for a certificate.

questions.question: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is best described as:
options: A replacement for all human intelligence
Technology that enables computers to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence

questions.question: Which type of AI is designed to perform a single specific task?
A prompt is:
options: An instruction or question given to an AI system

questions.question: Which characteristic usually produces better AI responses?
Which AI tool category is mainly used to summarize information and answer research questions?
What is one major benefit of AI productivity tools?
options: They remove the need for human thinking.
They automate repetitive tasks and improve efficiency.

questions.question: An AI workflow is:
options: A structured process where AI assists with different stages of completing a task

questions.question: Why should AI-generated content always be reviewed?
options: Because AI can produce inaccurate or incomplete information

questions.question: Which principle is part of responsible AI usage?
Which information should generally NOT be shared with AI systems?
What is AI bias?
options: When AI produces unfair or unbalanced results because of limitations in data or design

questions.question: An AI hallucination is:
options: A convincing but incorrect or fabricated AI response

questions.question: Plagiarism means:
options: Presenting someone else's work or ideas as your own without proper acknowledgment

questions.question: Which human skill remains especially valuable in the AI era?
What is the best way to use AI in education?
options: Use AI as a learning assistant while developing your own understanding
Copy AI answers into every assignment

questions.question: Why is lifelong learning important?
options: Because AI and technology continue to evolve
Because AI will eventually stop improving
Because education ends after one course

Which is a good cybersecurity practice?

The overall purpose of this course is to help learners:
options: Understand, apply and use AI responsibly in everyday life, education and work
